name: Teshie
blurb: A Ga fishing town on the coast east of Accra, stretching from the Kpeshie Lagoon to Nungua. Published accounts say it was founded around 1700 by people who left La, and it has long been called a warrior town. Today it is known for its canoes, its fantasy coffin carvers and its Homowo, the last of the Ga towns to celebrate it each year.
credits: Filmed and produced by Keen Eye Media Alliance
draftNote: Research draft. This page is drawn from published sources and has not yet been checked with Teshie's elders. We'll confirm or correct it during filming.

origin.teaser: Published family tradition says Numo Nmashie, second-in-command at La, left after a feud around 1710, bought land from the Nungua Mantse and founded Teshie. A historian descended from the founders dates it to the late 1600s.
